description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeAttachmentDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations and validation logic related to employee attachments, including saving, retrieving, and deleting attachments for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeAttachmentDao, verifying functionality related to employee attachment management in the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, including setting up the DAO and populating test data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee attachment and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentForFreshEmployee
methods.description: Tests attachment saving for a newly referenced employee.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentWithId
methods.description: Tests updating or saving an attachment with a specified attachment ID.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachmentWithInvalidScreen
methods.description: Verifies that setting an invalid screen value throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Checks retrieval of attachments for different employee screens.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a specific employee attachment by employee, attachment ID, and screen.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachmentWithoutScreen
methods.description: Checks retrieval of an attachment without specifying a screen.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple employee attachments.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachmentsWithWrongIdForScreen
methods.description: Verifies deletion behavior when incorrect attachment IDs are provided.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mock DateTimeHelperService to control the current datetime during tests.
